name: Templar Staffguard and Untainted apply the amounts their tooltips bill
contract: Staffguard 705295 reads 'absorbing ${$706583m1+$STA*.3} damage, scaling with Stamina, parry and dodge rating'. 706583 e0 is SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB BasePoints 124 with 5 points per level from BaseLevel 24; the CoA client shows $706583m1 at rank 0, 125. Untainted 705298 is streamed as 'reduces your Physical damage taken by ${-$705299m1+$STA*0.1}'; 705299 e0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_TAKEN physical BasePoints -11, $705299m1 = -10. Two level 80 Templars receive both auras; 'armored' first gets Power Word: Fortitude 48161, Increased Dodge 96 18062 and Increased Parry 100 18063. The applied Staffguard absorb must be 125 + 0.3 x Stamina + 0.25 x (dodge + parry rating) and the applied Untainted amount -(10 + 0.1 x Stamina). Measured stats 109 / 224 Stamina and 0 / 196 dodge plus parry rating give 157 / 241 absorbed and -20 / -32 (integer truncation). The level-scaled CalcValue alone would give 405 for Staffguard, and a lost Stamina term 125 and -10 on both Templars.
